summary: Validated the Realm Pulse founder analytics module + heartbeat + BannerEditor wiring. Backend: 17/17 pytest tests pass against /api/analytics/heartbeat (auth gate + idempotent same-day), /api/admin/realm-pulse/{overview,investor-snapshot,refresh-snapshot,export,diagnostics} (founder gate enforced, schema complete, non-founder = 403 'Founder only'), CSV/PDF/XLSX exports all return correct Content-Type + Content-Disposition: attachment, CSV first line == 'metric,value', PDF starts with %PDF-, XLSX starts with PK zip magic. Regression: /api/admin/storage/status, /api/hashtags/interest-cards(/analytics), /api/admin/moderation/copyright/queue all still 200 for founder. Frontend (Playwright against the live preview URL with localStorage key 'ourrealm.access'): /admin/realm-pulse renders with EVERY required testid (realm-pulse-page, investor-snapshot-card/status, realm-pulse-growth-tiles, rp-retention/engagement/growth/community/insights, realm-pulse-exports). Window switcher 7d/30d/custom all work — custom reveals realm-pulse-custom-range with date inputs. All four section toggles (engagement/growth/community/insights) expand. All three export buttons (rp-export-csv/xlsx/pdf) are present and a fetch to the export URL returns a non-empty binary with the right content-type. Non-founder (tfone) on /admin/realm-pulse correctly shows the 'Founder access only' realm-pulse-denied panel and NOT realm-pulse-page. /admin/analytics shows the open-realm-pulse pill which navigates to /admin/realm-pulse. /realms/gaming shows realm-banner-edit which opens the BannerEditor modal (data-testid=realm-banner-editor). Heartbeat smoke walk through /feed,/messages,/sounds,/profile,/realms/gaming produced ZERO heartbeat-related console errors (the only console errors observed are pre-existing AutoplayVideo MEDIA_ELEMENT_ERROR for two missing /api/videos/*.mov files + one unrelated 500 — these are not related to the current batch).
action_items: Optional cleanup (not blocking): three pre-existing AutoplayVideo media playback errors logged on /feed for /api/videos/abc.mp4 and two .mov files — these are leftover/broken video records in the feed, unrelated to this batch, but they create noisy console errors for every feed visit.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/realm_pulse.py is clean — every founder endpoint calls require_founder(current); heartbeat correctly accepts ANY authenticated user and is idempotent via the unique (user_id, day) index on user_activity_days.
Export route safely whitelists fmt to csv|pdf|xlsx (400 otherwise), reuses overview() so file content matches the dashboard, and sets Content-Disposition: attachment with a timestamped filename.
investor_snapshot endpoint defensively pops a hypothetical _counts key — good belt-and-braces in case future helpers leak per-user data.

Frontend gating: AdminAnalytics pill + RealmDetail banner-edit both correctly gate on user.username==='stealth' via useAuth(); apiClient reads the JWT from localStorage key 'ourrealm.access' (documented for future testing agents).
useHeartbeat hook is non-blocking on mount across Feed/Messages/Sounds/Profile/RealmDetail — no console errors during the smoke walk.
test_credentials: Founder stealth/Password1$ and user tfone/pass1234 both valid. Frontend localStorage JWT key is 'ourrealm.access' (not 'access_token').
seed_data_creation: Tests created two user_activity_days rows (one for the founder, one for tfone) for today's UTC date via /api/analytics/heartbeat, plus one fresh snapshot row in db.realm_pulse_snapshots from the refresh-snapshot test. Safe to leave.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Realm-Pulse backend regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_realm_pulse.py (17 tests, ~4s). Frontend Playwright auth shortcut: POST /api/auth/login then page.evaluate("(t)=>localStorage.setItem('ourrealm.access', t)", token) — DO NOT use access_token / token / auth_token keys; only 'ourrealm.access' is read by /app/frontend/src/api/client.js. All Realm Pulse data-testids are exactly as documented in the review request and all are present in the DOM.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Initial false negatives in the first Playwright run (missing open-realm-pulse pill + realm-banner-edit button) were caused by my test using the wrong localStorage key for the JWT — apiClient reads 'ourrealm.access', not 'access_token'/'token'. After switching to the correct key both elements rendered and worked as specified. The product code is correct.
